//: Kinds of relation (15 §9.1). What each means is this mod's; the engine reads only the four flags: `opposes` and `sides_with` tell enemies from friends (09 §3.4), `orders` makes an order one to obey (15 §10), `intervenes` makes the holder a candidate for windows opened against whom it is held toward (03 §7.1).
name: friendly
doc: Good will: held above nothing, the one it is held toward is a friend. Fades slowly.

name: hostile
doc: Ill will: held above nothing, the one it is held toward is an enemy. Fades over hours.

name: afraid
doc: Fear of someone: what makes a character run rather than fight. Fades within the hour.

name: loyal
doc: Held by a servant toward its master: it obeys their orders, counts them a friend and steps in for them. A summoned or raised servant is made with it; lose it and it is no longer a servant.

name: employed by
doc: Held by someone in another's pay toward whoever pays them: it does what it is told, as work, and no more.

name: guards
doc: Held by a bodyguard toward whom it protects: it is offered the windows opened against them.
